summary: The analysis indicates generally good glucose management with some variability. The profile settings and AAPS automation are generally appropriate but require some adjustments for better glucose control.

analysis_steps.findings: Good CGM coverage with minor gaps.
analysis_steps.evidence: CGM data coverage is 98.7% over 14 days.

analysis_steps.findings: TIR is 86%, with some hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia events.
analysis_steps.evidence: TIR, time above range, and time below range statistics.

analysis_steps.findings: Basal rates and targets seem reasonable but need further analysis.
analysis_steps.evidence: Basal rates vary from 0.5 to 0.8 U/h. Targets are generally around 90 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into overnight basal due to lack of detailed overnight glucose data.

analysis_steps.findings: CR and ISF settings need evaluation against meal and correction bolus responses.
analysis_steps.evidence: CR varies from 10.5 to 13.2 g/U. ISF is constant at 56 mg/dL/U. DIA is 10 hours.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Need more insight into meal boluses and their effects.

analysis_steps.findings: Aggressive SMB settings with frequent boluses. UAM is enabled.
analysis_steps.evidence: SMB interval is 3 minutes, and max SMB basal minutes are 15 for SMB and 20 for UAM.

analysis_steps.findings: Dynamic ISF is used. High max IOB could be a safety concern.
analysis_steps.evidence: Dynamic ISF is enabled with a 70% adjustment factor. Max IOB is 25 U.

analysis_steps.findings: No meal bolus data available. Reliance on correction boluses and SMB/UAM.
analysis_steps.evidence: No carb entries or meal bolus data.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Meal bolus and carb entry data.

analysis_steps.evidence: No carb entries or e-carb data.

analysis_steps.findings: Recommend adjustments to max IOB and potentially ISF based on observed glucose variability.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Meal data for better understanding of glucose responses.

strengths: Generally appropriate basal rates and targets
issues: High max IOB could be a safety risk

recommendations.title: Reduce max IOB
recommendations.description: High max IOB (25 U) could be a safety risk. Consider reducing it to a more conservative value.

recommendations.title: Review ISF
recommendations.description: ISF is constant at 56 mg/dL/U. Reviewing ISF against glucose variability may be beneficial.

profile_recommendation.recommendation: Keep ISF at 56 mg/dL/U and monitor glucose variability.
profile_recommendation.rationale: ISF seems generally appropriate but could be adjusted based on further analysis of glucose variability.
profile_recommendation.next_check: Monitor glucose variability over the next week.
